mp_senet.name: MP-SENet
mp_senet.tagline: Explicit Parallel Magnitude and Phase Estimation
mp_senet.description: State-of-the-art neural speech enhancement using dual-path Time-Frequency Transformers. Explicitly estimates magnitude and phase spectra in parallel to eliminate phase-cancellation flutter and metallic/robotic artifacts. Natural voice contours and crisp consonants.
mp_senet.best_for: Professional narration, podcast dialogue, voice-over, commercial post-production
mp_senet.paper: Explicit Estimation of Magnitude and Phase Spectra in Parallel for High-Quality Speech Enhancement (Interspeech / IEEE/ACM TASLP)

zipenhancer.name: ZipEnhancer-S
zipenhancer.description: Lightweight high-efficiency model based on the ICASSP 2025 Zipformer architecture with BiasNorm and Non-Linear Attention. Smooth background suppression, warm vocal presence, and minimal high-frequency harshness.
zipenhancer.best_for: General dialogue, YouTube content, long interviews, low-VRAM GPUs
zipenhancer.paper: ZipEnhancer: Dual-Path Down-Up Sampling-based Zipformer for Monaural Speech Enhancement (ICASSP 2025)

mossformergan.name: MossFormerGAN-SE
mossformergan.description: High-powered speech enhancement featuring the MossFormer attention backbone with dual spectral and masking decoders. Delivers exceptional high-frequency speech presence and consonant bite. Requires significant GPU VRAM.
mossformergan.best_for: Difficult acoustic environments, heavy street/restaurant noise, high-treble vocal cleanup
mossformergan.paper: ClearerVoice-Studio: An Open-Source Processing Suite for Speech Enhancement, Separation, and Dereverberation (arXiv:2407.03901)

deepfilternet3.name: DeepFilterNet3
deepfilternet3.description: Lightweight, fullband 48 kHz neural speech enhancement framework using deep filtering on complex ERB bands. Native 48 kHz processing with zero downsampling. Extremely CPU-friendly and runs fast on any system without dedicated GPU.
deepfilternet3.best_for: Laptops on battery, CPU-only machines, rapid drafts, background speech cleanup
deepfilternet3.speed_label: Ultra Fast (~15× on GPU, ~3× on CPU)
deepfilternet3.vram_requirement: Minimal (~150 MB or 0 MB on CPU)
deepfilternet3.paper: DeepFilterNet: A Low-Complexity Speech Enhancement Framework for Full-Band Audio (TASLP)
